source_os_skips.condition: Runtime skips if UDP route discovery finds no non-loopback address.

adaptations: Each frozen source ID expands to one separately reported Rust #[test] with a documented exact source ID; no generic case dispatcher, source runtime, ignored test, or fixture-equality substitute is used.

Protocol fixtures are independent actual local TCP servers for authenticated HTTP, SOCKS4a, SOCKS5, origin requests, body forwarding, tunnels, refusals and worker shutdown. Synthetic fixture credentials never leave the owned local endpoints.
All HTTP API cases use the production native router and real owned data roots. CLI assertions use the production native command services and typed Result/Outcome output.

Filesystem cases build actual ZIP/CRX bytes, unpacked manifests, locale catalogs, icon bytes, protected outside targets and OS directory links. Package extraction preflights every member before creating the destination.

Test-support hooks are scoped typed observers or explicit local policy/dependency injection around actual production service functions; no global product fault environment settings exist. Detailed source-language/API adaptations are recorded per case.

Native relay construction cannot represent an unstarted or restartable Python relay instance; constructor-readiness and repeated-close cases are documented structural adaptations. No source assertion is represented solely by a test count.

Original optional dependency skips become native implementations linked into this feature-gated target. Original platform applicability is retained with Unix symlinks or Windows junctions; no native tests are ignored.

verification.command: cargo test --manifest-path engine-rust/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features test-support --test source_network --test source_contracts --test source_domain -- --test-threads=8
verification.clippy: passed: cargo clippy --manifest-path engine-rust/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features test-support --test source_network -- -D warnings
verification.format: passed: rustfmt --check on all owned files
fixed_regressions: The downloader refuses invalid raw extension IDs before request URL construction.
Extension target link refusals retain a useful reason.
Extension ZIP preflight covers every directory/file before creating missing destination folders.
Both SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 health checks retain protocol failure diagnostics.
Relay 502 bodies retain the actual safe upstream refusal reason.
